description: Verify that a registered user can log in with valid email and password.
expected_result: The user is authenticated and redirected to the dashboard.

description: Verify that the system rejects login when the password is incorrect.
expected_result: The user remains on the login page and sees an invalid credentials message.

description: Verify that required field validation appears when login fields are empty.
expected_result: The system displays required field validation and does not submit the form.
